mapper.select: SELECT category_id, parent_id, goal_type, category_name, ncs_code, category_level, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_category WHERE goal_type = #{goalType} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY category_level, category_name
SELECT univ_id, univ_name, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_transfer_university WHERE del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY univ_name

SELECT tm.major_id, tm.univ_id, tm.major_code, tmc.major_name, tm.admission_year, tm.created_date, tm.created_nm, tm.modified_date, tm.modified_nm, tm.del_yn FROM job_transfer_major tm JOIN job_transfer_major_category tmc ON tmc.major_code = tm.major_code AND tmc.del_yn = 'N' WHERE tm.univ_id = #{univId} AND tm.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY tmc.major_name

SELECT q.qual_id, q.qual_type, q.external_code, q.data_source, q.qual_name, q.qual_summary, q.organization_name, q.written_fee, q.practical_fee, q.military_fee, q.detail_url, q.last_synced_date,
schedule.exam_year, schedule.exam_round, schedule.written_reg_start_date, schedule.written_reg_end_date, schedule.written_exam_start_date, schedule.written_exam_end_date, schedule.written_result_date, schedule.practical_reg_start_date, schedule.practical_reg_end_date, schedule.practical_exam_start_date, schedule.practical_exam_end_date, schedule.practical_result_date,
q.created_date, q.created_nm, q.modified_date, q.modified_nm, q.del_yn
FROM job_category_qualification cq
JOIN job_qualification q ON q.qual_id = cq.qual_id AND q.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_qualification_schedule schedule ON schedule.schedule_id = ( SELECT s.schedule_id FROM job_qualification_schedule s WHERE s.qual_id = q.qual_id AND s.del_yn = 'N' AND ( s.written_reg_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.written_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.practical_reg_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.practical_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() ) ORDER BY s.exam_year, s.schedule_id LIMIT 1 )
WHERE cq.category_id = #{categoryId} AND cq.del_yn = 'N'
ORDER BY q.qual_type, q.qual_id

SELECT q.qual_id, q.qual_type, q.external_code, q.data_source, q.qual_name, q.qual_summary, q.organization_name, q.written_fee, q.practical_fee, q.military_fee, q.detail_url, q.last_synced_date,
schedule.exam_year, schedule.exam_round, schedule.written_reg_start_date, schedule.written_reg_end_date, schedule.written_exam_start_date, schedule.written_exam_end_date, schedule.written_result_date, schedule.practical_reg_start_date, schedule.practical_reg_end_date, schedule.practical_exam_start_date, schedule.practical_exam_end_date, schedule.practical_result_date,
q.created_date, q.created_nm, q.modified_date, q.modified_nm, q.del_yn
FROM job_transfer_major tm
JOIN job_transfer_major_qualification mq ON mq.major_code = tm.major_code AND mq.del_yn = 'N'
JOIN job_qualification q ON q.qual_id = mq.qual_id AND q.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_qualification_schedule schedule ON schedule.schedule_id = ( SELECT s.schedule_id FROM job_qualification_schedule s WHERE s.qual_id = q.qual_id AND s.del_yn = 'N' AND ( s.written_reg_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.written_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.practical_reg_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.practical_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() ) ORDER BY s.exam_year, s.schedule_id LIMIT 1 )
WHERE tm.major_id = #{majorId} AND tm.del_yn = 'N'
ORDER BY q.qual_type, q.qual_id

SELECT DISTINCT qc.qual_id, c.course_id, c.course_type, c.provider_name, c.course_name, c.original_price, c.discount_price, c.military_price, c.benefit_detail, c.detail_url, c.created_date, c.created_nm, c.modified_date, c.modified_nm, c.del_yn FROM job_qualification_course qc JOIN job_course c ON c.course_id = qc.course_id AND c.del_yn = 'N' WHERE qc.del_yn = 'N'
AND qc.qual_id IN
#{qualId}
ORDER BY c.course_name

SELECT c.course_id, c.course_type, c.provider_name, c.course_name, c.original_price, c.discount_price, c.military_price, c.benefit_detail, c.detail_url, c.created_date, c.created_nm, c.modified_date, c.modified_nm, c.del_yn FROM job_category_course cc JOIN job_course c ON c.course_id = cc.course_id WHERE cc.category_id = #{categoryId} AND cc.del_yn='N' AND c.del_yn='N' ORDER BY c.course_name

SELECT c.course_id, c.course_type, c.provider_name, c.course_name, c.original_price, c.discount_price, c.military_price, c.benefit_detail, c.detail_url, c.created_date, c.created_nm, c.modified_date, c.modified_nm, c.del_yn FROM job_transfer_major tm JOIN job_transfer_major_course mc ON mc.major_code = tm.major_code JOIN job_course c ON c.course_id = mc.course_id WHERE tm.major_id = #{majorId} AND tm.del_yn='N' AND mc.del_yn='N' AND c.del_yn='N' ORDER BY c.course_name

SELECT service_id, service_type, goal_type, service_name, service_qual, service_desc, service_url, external_code, last_synced_date, sort_order, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_recommend_service WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND ( goal_type = #{goalType} OR goal_type IS NULL ) ORDER BY service_type, sort_order, service_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_goal (user_id,goal_type,category_id,univ_id,major_id,expected_date, status,created_date,created_nm,del_yn) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalType}, #{categoryId}, #{univId}, #{majorId}, #{expectedDate}, 'DRAFT', NOW(), #{createdNm},'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE job_goal SET goal_type = #{goalType}, category_id = #{categoryId}, univ_id = #{univId}, major_id = #{majorId}, expected_date = #{expectedDate}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO job_goal_qualification ( goal_id, qual_id, selected_cost, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES
( #{goalId}, #{qualification.qualId}, #{qualification.selectedCost}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE selected_cost = VALUES(selected_cost), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = VALUES(created_nm), del_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO job_goal_training ( goal_id, external_code, training_round, institution_id, training_name, institution_name, training_type, address, training_cost, selected_cost, start_date, end_date, detail_url, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES
( #{goalId}, #{training.externalCode}, #{training.trainingRound}, #{training.institutionId}, #{training.trainingName}, #{training.institutionName}, #{training.trainingType}, #{training.address}, #{training.trainingCost}, #{training.selectedCost}, #{training.startDate}, #{training.endDate}, #{training.detailUrl}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE institution_id = VALUES(institution_id), training_name = VALUES(training_name), institution_name = VALUES(institution_name), training_type = VALUES(training_type), address = VALUES(address), training_cost = VALUES(training_cost), selected_cost = VALUES(selected_cost), start_date = VALUES(start_date), end_date = VALUES(end_date), detail_url = VALUES(detail_url), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = VALUES(created_nm), del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, user_id, goal_type, category_id, univ_id, major_id, expected_date, status, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_goal WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT goal_id FROM job_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY goal_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.qual_id, q.qual_type, q.external_code, q.data_source, q.qual_name, q.qual_summary, q.organization_name, q.written_fee, q.practical_fee, q.military_fee, gq.selected_cost, q.detail_url, q.last_synced_date,
schedule.exam_year, schedule.exam_round, schedule.written_reg_start_date, schedule.written_reg_end_date, schedule.written_exam_start_date, schedule.written_exam_end_date, schedule.written_result_date, schedule.practical_reg_start_date, schedule.practical_reg_end_date, schedule.practical_exam_start_date, schedule.practical_exam_end_date, schedule.practical_result_date,
q.created_date, q.created_nm, q.modified_date, q.modified_nm, q.del_yn FROM job_goal_qualification gq JOIN job_qualification q ON q.qual_id = gq.qual_id AND q.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_qualification_schedule schedule ON schedule.schedule_id = ( SELECT s.schedule_id FROM job_qualification_schedule s WHERE s.qual_id = q.qual_id AND s.del_yn = 'N' AND ( s.written_reg_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.written_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.practical_reg_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s.practical_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() ) ORDER BY s.exam_year, s.schedule_id LIMIT 1 ) WHERE gq.goal_id = #{goalId} AND gq.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY gq.goal_qual_id

SELECT c.course_id, c.course_type, c.provider_name, c.course_name, c.original_price, c.discount_price, c.military_price, gc.selected_cost, c.benefit_detail, c.detail_url, c.created_date, c.created_nm, c.modified_date, c.modified_nm, c.del_yn FROM job_goal_course gc JOIN job_course c ON c.course_id = gc.course_id AND c.del_yn = 'N' WHERE gc.goal_id = #{goalId} AND gc.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY gc.goal_course_id

SELECT goal_training_id, goal_id, external_code, training_round, institution_id, training_name, institution_name, training_cost, selected_cost, address, start_date, end_date, detail_url, training_type, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_goal_training WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY goal_training_id

SELECT g.goal_id, g.goal_type,
g.category_id, c.category_name,
g.univ_id, u.univ_name,
g.major_id, mc.major_name,
g.expected_date, g.status
FROM job_goal g
LEFT JOIN job_category c ON c.category_id = g.category_id AND c.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_transfer_university u ON u.univ_id = g.univ_id AND u.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_transfer_major tm ON tm.major_id = g.major_id AND tm.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_transfer_major_category mc ON mc.major_code = tm.major_code AND mc.del_yn = 'N'
WHERE g.goal_id = #{goalId} AND g.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT qual_id, qual_type, external_code, data_source, qual_name, qual_summary, organization_name, written_fee, practical_fee, military_fee, detail_url, last_synced_date, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_qualification WHERE data_source = 'D02' AND external_code IS NOT NULL AND external_code != '' AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY qual_id
mapper.update: UPDATE job_qualification SET written_fee = COALESCE(#{writtenFee}, written_fee), practical_fee = COALESCE(#{practicalFee}, practical_fee), last_synced_date = NOW(), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = 'QNET_BATCH' WHERE qual_id = #{qualId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO job_qualification_schedule ( qual_id, exam_year, exam_round,
written_reg_start_date, written_reg_end_date, written_exam_start_date, written_exam_end_date, written_result_date,
practical_reg_start_date, practical_reg_end_date, practical_exam_start_date, practical_exam_end_date, practical_result_date,
last_synced_date, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{qualId}, #{examYear}, #{examRound},
#{schedule.writtenRegStartDate}, #{schedule.writtenRegEndDate}, #{schedule.writtenExamStartDate}, #{schedule.writtenExamEndDate}, #{schedule.writtenResultDate},
#{schedule.practicalRegStartDate}, #{schedule.practicalRegEndDate}, #{schedule.practicalExamStartDate}, #{schedule.practicalExamEndDate}, #{schedule.practicalResultStartDate},
NOW(), NOW(), 'QNET_BATCH', 'N' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE written_reg_start_date = COALESCE(VALUES(written_reg_start_date), written_reg_start_date), written_reg_end_date = COALESCE(VALUES(written_reg_end_date), written_reg_end_date),
written_exam_start_date = COALESCE(VALUES(written_exam_start_date), written_exam_start_date), written_exam_end_date = COALESCE(VALUES(written_exam_end_date), written_exam_end_date),
written_result_date = COALESCE(VALUES(written_result_date), written_result_date),
practical_reg_start_date = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_reg_start_date), practical_reg_start_date), practical_reg_end_date = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_reg_end_date), practical_reg_end_date),
practical_exam_start_date = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_exam_start_date), practical_exam_start_date), practical_exam_end_date = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_exam_end_date), practical_exam_end_date),
practical_result_date = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_result_date), practical_result_date),
last_synced_date = NOW(), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = 'QNET_BATCH', del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT jc.category_id, jc.parent_id, jc.goal_type, jc.category_name, jc.ncs_code, jc.category_level FROM job_goal jg JOIN job_category jc ON jc.category_id = jg.category_id WHERE jg.goal_id = #{goalId} AND jg.del_yn = 'N' AND jc.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT child.category_id FROM job_category parent JOIN job_category child ON child.parent_id = parent.category_id AND child.del_yn = 'N' WHERE parent.course_mapping_code = #{courseMappingCode} AND parent.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY child.category_id
SELECT category_id FROM job_category WHERE course_mapping_code = #{courseMappingCode} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT major_code FROM job_transfer_major_category WHERE ( course_mapping_code = #{courseMappingCode} OR course_mapping_code = 'BOTH' ) AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY major_code
SELECT major_code FROM job_transfer_major_category WHERE del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY major_code

SELECT qual_id, qual_type, external_code, data_source, qual_name, qual_summary, organization_name, written_fee, practical_fee, military_fee, detail_url, last_synced_date, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM job_qualification WHERE qual_type = #{qualType} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY qual_id
SELECT course_id FROM job_course WHERE provider_name = #{providerName} AND course_name = #{courseName} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY course_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_course ( course_type, provider_name, course_name, original_price, discount_price, military_price, benefit_detail, detail_url, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{courseType}, #{providerName}, #{courseName}, #{originalPrice}, #{discountPrice}, #{militaryPrice}, #{benefitDetail}, #{detailUrl}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE job_course SET course_type = #{courseType}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, discount_price = #{discountPrice}, military_price = #{militaryPrice}, benefit_detail = #{benefitDetail}, detail_url = #{detailUrl}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm}, del_yn = 'N' WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO job_qualification_course ( qual_id, course_id, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{qualId}, #{courseId}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = VALUES(created_nm), del_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO job_category_course ( category_id, course_id, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{courseId}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = VALUES(created_nm), del_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO job_transfer_major_course ( major_code, course_id, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{majorCode}, #{courseId}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = VALUES(created_nm), del_yn = 'N'
